name: Sukuna's Finger
description: (Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)A finger containing 1/20th of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses, radiating incredible cursed energy that attracts cursed lifeforms. A cursed being that ingests it gains a power boost, while a proper vessel will either incarnate as 1/20th Sukuna, share the vessel with him, or defeat his fragment and consume its power.
